definitions.explanation: Describes something that can be done without much effort or difficulty. More formal and literary than やさしい or 簡単.

examples.japanese: たやすいことではない。
{信頼|しんらい}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}すのはたやすくない。
{長年|ながねん}の{習慣|しゅうかん}をたやすく{変|か}えることはできない。
examples.english: You can't easily change habits built up over many years.

notes:
たやすい can also be written as {容易|たやす}い. It is more formal than {簡単|かんたん} or やさしい and is often used in negative constructions to emphasize difficulty.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- たやすいことではない: it's no easy matter
- たやすく〜できない: cannot easily ~
- たやすく{手|て}に{入|はい}る: to be easily obtained

USAGE: More commonly encountered in written Japanese and formal speech. In casual conversation, {簡単|かんたん} or {楽|らく} are preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {簡単|かんたん}: easy, simple (most common, neutral)
- やさしい: easy (common, slightly softer tone)
- たやすい: easy (formal, literary)
- {容易|ようい}: easy (formal, often in {容易|ようい}ではない)
